purpose: Cover every acceptance criterion of US-18003 with one node:test case each in test/view/readiness-tables.test.js; DEFINE lands the named declarations flagged not yet built so the strict coverage audit binds each criterion, and BUILD (FBS-204) removes the flags as it makes them pass.

testCases.description: [happy] Given readiness.questions is non-empty, when the questions sub-view renders, then it is one table with one QuestionRow per question carrying QuestionRow.number, QuestionRow.ask, QuestionRow.location as a link that opens the item in full context, QuestionRow.settles in plain words and QuestionRow.state, and the group label is a sortable column rather than a heading.

[edge] Given a question whose itemId is not a document id (a brief statement such as "brief-ledger" or a profile field such as "profile:surface"), when the row renders, then QuestionRow.locationHref is "#tab=readiness&sub=questions&entity=<itemId>" and the router lands on that row, so the page never emits a dead anchor.
testCases.testPointer: test/view/readiness-tables.test.js::AC-18003-2 edge: a question whose itemid is not a document id a b

testCases.description: [happy] Given every failing check across stages, when the blocking sub-view renders, then it is one table with one BlockingRow per failing item carrying BlockingRow.stage, BlockingRow.check, BlockingRow.docId as a link, BlockingRow.why from the gate and BlockingRow.resolved in plain words, with no cap on the number of rows and a FilterBar by stage and persona.
testCases.testPointer: test/view/readiness-tables.test.js::AC-18003-3 happy: every failing check across stages

testCases.description: [edge] Given a composite failing id such as "AC-060-3:userID" or "TAC-4122-define-gates:checkPersona", when its row renders, then BlockingRow.docId is the text before the first colon, BlockingRow.fragment is the remainder and BlockingRow.href targets the document id so the link resolves through findByDocId.
testCases.testPointer: test/view/readiness-tables.test.js::AC-18003-4 edge: a composite failing id such as ac0603userid or t

testCases.description: [happy] Given a question row, when the copy control renders, then QuestionRow.briefHandle is one line holding the item id and the plain-English ask, the control is labelled "Copy for your agent" and copies that line through the existing toast feedback, and the line holds no command text.

[failure] Given readiness could not be computed (the readiness object is null), when the Readiness tab renders, then the existing "could not be computed" placeholder is shown and no table is rendered.
testCases.testPointer: test/view/readiness-tables.test.js::AC-18003-6 failure: readiness could not be computed the readiness ob

testCases.description: [must-not] Given any register and any tree, when the panel renders for the command page, then the panel contains no shell command text (no "pnpm rcf", no "rcf define", no "rcf audit"), no write control and no "Freeze now" button.
testCases.testPointer: test/view/readiness-tables.test.js::AC-18003-7 must-not: any register and any tree

testCases.description: [happy] Given the profile register is "engineer", when the tab first paints, then the blocking table precedes the questions table; given "productOwner" or no profile, the questions table precedes the blocking table; in both cases both tables are present in the DOM.
testCases.testPointer: test/view/readiness-tables.test.js::AC-18003-8 happy: the profile register is engineer

title: US-18003 command page suite (readiness-tables)
